messages:
Marta: Microwave hack thread — what's one weird microwave trick you swear by? Need to salvage leftover quinoa tonight.
Sam: Cover food with a damp paper towel. Stops it from drying out and keeps texture nicer.
Devon: :popcorn: Pro tip — put a cup of water next to veggie dishes to prevent splatter and add moisture.
Leo: If you care about crust/pizza: microwave 45s with a ramekin of water, then 30s at 30%. Or to crisp, finish in a skillet 60s.
Gloria: Wrap burrito in damp paper towel and nuke in 1min bursts. Also poke holes in sausages so they don't explode :grimacing:
Michelle: For scrambled eggs: whisk w/ milk in a microwave-safe bowl, cover, 30s, stir, 20s. Comes out fluffy.
Sam: also — ceramic mug of water = even heating. Science. :nerd_face:
Marta: Awesome, trying the mug trick rn :eyes:
kitchen-bot: Reminder: Do NOT put metal in microwave. If you make a mess, please clean it up afterwards :sparkles:
